findings.quote: and made their voyage back, as unexpectedly as they had come
findings.problem: Greek: ῥίψαντες τὰ ὅπλα παναίσχρως, ἅμα δ᾽ ἀνελπίστως ἐποιήσατο τὸν ἀπόπλουν. ἀνελπίστως paired with παναίσχρως means in despair / without hope, not 'as unexpectedly as they had come'; the comparison with their arrival is not in the Greek.
findings.proposed_fix: and made their voyage back, in utter disgrace and without hope

units.note: Only weak finding; ἀνελπίστως can also mean 'unexpectedly' in Polybius, but the added clause 'as they had come' has no Greek basis.
